name: prnp_duplex
_note: DNA-only duplex fold to produce the B-form target for rfd3na. Matches Sehgal et al. target prep (single diffusion sample). Run GPU-side via pecli protenix; the resulting duplex CIF is the rfd3na conditioning target. Chains are lettered in sequences order, so sense=A, antisense=B.
_seed_note: The paper uses AF3 seed 42. protenix reads 'modelSeeds' ONLY when --use-seeds-in-json is set; pecli's --seeds governs by default. So request the seed explicitly: pecli prepare protenix --input this.json --seeds 42 --sample 1
_schema_note: protenix requires a top-level LIST, the entity key 'dnaSequence' (not 'dna'), and 'count' on every entity. The previous version of this file used the AF3-server/Boltz spelling {'dna': {'id': 'A', ...}} inside a top-level object; pecli's prepare-time validator rejects that, so it had never been folded.
_msa_note: pecli auto-routes any protenix fold lacking a precomputed MSA to a paid 'msa -> protenix' pipeline, and it does this even for a DNA-only input where there is no protein chain to align. Pass --public-msa to opt out of that routing and run the fold bare.
